tool.name: Read Count
tool.description: Count the reads in FASTQ or FASTA files.
tool.command:
#import re #if $input_files.single_or_collection.input_single_or_collection == "single" #set $files = [$input_files.single_or_collection.query] #elif $input_files.single_or_collection.input_single_or_collection == "collection" #set $files = list($input_files.single_or_collection.query) #end if
## Write one line for every file, named after its (sanitised) dataset ## name or collection element identifier. set -e; : > '$output'; #for $file in $files #set $safe_id = re.sub('[^A-Za-z0-9._-]', '_', str($file.element_identifier)) gawk --sandbox -v name='$safe_id' #if $file.ext.startswith('fasta') '/^>/ {n++} END {printf "%s: %d reads
", name, n}' #else 'END {printf "%s: %d reads
", name, NR / 4}' #end if '$file' >> '$output'; #end for
## Add up the counts of a collection on a final line. #if $input_files.single_or_collection.input_single_or_collection == "collection" gawk --sandbox '{total += \$2} END {printf "Total: %d reads
", total}' '$output' >> '$output'; #end if

param.name: input_single_or_collection
param.label: Input single file or collection
param.help: Choose whether to count the reads in a single file or in every file of a collection (default = single)
param.option: collection of FASTQ or FASTA files

param.name: query
param.label: FASTQ or FASTA files
param.help: A list collection of reads to count. FASTQ and FASTA files can be mixed

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark See GAWK documentation: https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/manual/ for full software details.
**What it does** Counts the reads in a FASTQ or FASTA file, or in every file of a list collection, and writes one line for every file: ``name: N reads``. For a collection, a final ``Total: N reads`` line adds them all up.
FASTA reads are counted by their > header lines. FASTQ reads are counted as four lines per read.
.. class:: warningmark Names are the dataset names or collection element identifiers. Every character other than a letter, digit, dot, underscore or hyphen is replaced by an underscore.
